segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin (including with large pores or a T-zone issue) report the wash controls oiliness and works well as part of their routine, though one long-time user in her 40s found it did not lather and left her blackheads unchanged.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe their skin as dry generally say the wash does not strip or dry it further and some pair it with extra moisturizer, though one reviewer with dry skin still developed acne and increased dryness on this product.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including those with an oily T-zone and occasional hormonal breakouts, report it helps manage breakouts without over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin mostly report no irritation and some improvement in redness or rosacea, but one reviewer with sensitive skin had worsening breakouts and disliked the smell, and another found it too irritating to use all over the face.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s with more oily, larger-pored mature skin found the wash ineffective and irritating (burning eyes, dull rough skin), while a 48-year-old reviewer using it alongside her teenage daughter reports balanced, clear skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer bought the product as a gift hoping for collagen/elasticity benefits, and one mature-skin reviewer reported reduced age-spot-adjacent breakouts, but there is little direct evidence of anti-aging effect described.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the wash does not dry out or tighten their skin even with daily use, but a few say it made their skin notably drier or that they needed to add extra moisturizer afterward.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness or soothed rosacea after use, but at least one reviewer's face turned red initially before improving, and one review reports ongoing irritation with no redness relief.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers combining this cleanser with actives (vitamin C, retinol, acids) report it does not sensitize skin before those actives, and most describe no compromise to skin comfort, though a minority report new irritation or burning.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report blackheads and stubborn whiteheads clearing after weeks of consistent use, with one describing a purge phase before blackheads disappeared and another noting persistent blackheads despite regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with active acne (cystic, hormonal, nodular, or teen acne) report visible reduction in breakouts over weeks, often after an initial purge; however, several reviewers report breakouts worsened or did not improve, including some who stopped using it.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describing oily or T-zone-oily skin report the wash leaves skin feeling clean without excess oil or greasiness, with no dissenting reports on this specific point.

aspects.libelle: Menthol burns eyes if too close

extraits.texte: I'm a lifelong Dermalogica user.. In my 40s now, skin has become more oily, larger pores, etc. So I tried this new wash— it did not lather, face did not feel clean after washing, skin felt rough and dull looking, the strong menthol in it burned my eyes. And.. my blackheads are still present. I'll just be switching back to their Special Cleansing Gel and oil-free Active Moist, with an occasional exfoliant 👌

I love Dermalogica but this product didn't do much for me. I have oily, relatively sensitive skin that loves salicylic acid. Now that I have my skin relatively under control, I know my breakouts are pretty much all hormonal. I never felt like this irritated my skin or anything but I also feel like it didn't really do it's job of clearing blemishes. I never felt like my skin got better using it. I've tried using it it periodically throughout the week and I've tried using it every night and can't tell if it's helping. I think it works as a cleanser in general, but I can't honestly say it helped acne. So I won't be getting more.

I've been struggling with deep acne and surface acne for as long as I can remember and have tried probably 100's of different face washes, serums, etc but I finally found something that works. I will never go back after using this. My skin is clearer and smoother and it's brought almost all of my deep acne to the surface. I have sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate that either (unlike a lot of other options I've tried). I am just so so happy with this cleanser!

extraits.titre: Cleared me and my daughter's skin
extraits.texte: I have very sensative skin, and redness around my nose amd cheeks, but after using this for a week, my redness went away. Nothing worked for me, but after using this product, I was stunned. Now my daughter has very bad acne. We have tried so manyndodferent brands on her. She started using this, and at first, she broke out a little more. But, I told her to give it awhile before she tosses it out. Glad I did, because her face cleared up. It took her a month for her entire face to clear, but she wqs consistant with washing it day and night, also minimal makeup wear. Im so glad we found a formula that dinally works. We have tried so mamy brands, even top brands, and this is the winner!

extraits.titre: Does work but don't use right before a big event
extraits.texte: I've been using this face wash for over a month now and I have to say that my face is clearer and smoother than it's ever been. BUT! I experienced some MAJOR purging. my acne tends to be hard bumps under the skin and with that being said, the first time I used this, I had hard filliments coming out of my pores. I have a medium sized scar on my face and the pores around that area are enlarged. I've taken a black head tool to that area, pore strips, black head masks, and nothing worked until this cleanser on the first day! very gross but also very satisfying. I was purging in my typical acne prone areas, but the "pimples" would disappear within a day or immediately pop and be gone. hence the purging and not actually breaking me out. it took about 3 weeks for the purging to stop. l used some extra rounds of the Ordinary's 30% acid peel mask followed by a clay mask to help assist the purging effects. I've had some bad acne most of my life and even after turning 30, that hasn't changed for me. this cleanser has really transformed my skin. I do use a vitamin c serum during the day and a retinol at night and this cleanser does not sensitize my face before going in with my actives. I use it morning and night. I cannot say how this removes makeup as I use an oil cleanser to remove makeup and then this cleanser afterwards. the cleanser does have menthol in it. my skin is usually irritated with menthol products, but this one does not irritate my skin at all. if you are sensitive to smel

extraits.titre: I'm on my second bottle of this
extraits.texte: This is absolutely worth the price! I have dry skin, rosacea and acne. This helps a lot with keeping my skin clear, but my face never feels tight or dried out from it. It seems to help soothe the rosacea a little too. Do use caution around the eyes, it has a light menthol fragrance and feel which can make your eyes burn a little if you get it too close.

I love this face wash. I have combination skin that tends to be more oily than anything else with an occasional breakout. I tend to stay away from gel cleansers because they make my skin feel too dry. This one doesn't do that at all. It lathers up nicely but doesn't leave my skin feeling like it's been stripped of all its natural oils. I also really love how tingly it it makes my skin feel.
